description: Two of four server/8.0/javascript-udfs/ pages carry verbatim, unadapted Capella wording. calling-javascript-from-n1ql.md and handling-errors-javascript-udf.md both retain the sentence 'For more information about user-defined functions in Capella...' on a Server documentation page; the sibling page calling-n1ql-from-javascript.md has the correctly adapted 'in Couchbase Server' wording for the identical sentence pattern, proving the adaptation was done inconsistently rather than never attempted. calling-javascript-from-n1ql.md additionally retains the Capella-only UI term 'Query tab' a few lines before correctly using 'Query Workbench' - a half-completed find/replace on one page.
